biggestRisk: The family grown-up is built on the existing global, first-come `grownup` role (sign up on Pages/Grownups, claimGrownup, then createChild/listChildren/... gated `role:grownup`). Only the first account on the backend can ever hold that role, so only one family can ever set up children, and that parent is also the content admin for everyone. Every other family's grown-up gets `alreadyClaimed`. The plan saw the first-account limit and filed it as 'out of scope' instead of designing a separate parent role. Second risk: it never says that the 127.0.0.1 backend has to be deployed somewhere another device can reach.
